title: Stochastic Compositional Optimization via Hybrid Momentum Frank--Wolfe
abstract: arXiv:2605.15350v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Stochastic compositional optimization minimizes $F(f(x), x)$ over a compact convex set when the inner map $f$ is available only through noisy samples. We propose Hybrid Momentum Stochastic Frank--Wolfe, a projection-free method for outer functions $F$ that are jointly convex and Lipschitz but not necessarily differentiable, such as maxima, CVaR, and norms. The method tracks the Jacobian and the value of $f$ with momentum, using a Taylor correction for the value, and passes the tracked linearization to a generalized linear minimization oracle. Under finite-variance noise, it attains an expected generalized Frank--Wolfe gap of order $K^{-1/4}$ for non-convex objectives and, when the linearized models minorize the objective, a last-iterate primal error of order $K^{-1/3}$. translated_title: 基于混合动量Frank--Wolfe的随机复合优化
translated_abstract: 随机复合优化研究在紧凸集上最小化 F(f(x), x)，其中内层映射 f 只能通过带噪样本获得。我们提出混合动量随机Frank--Wolfe方法，这是一种无投影方法，适用于联合凸且Lipschitz连续但未必可微的外层函数 F，例如最大值、CVaR（条件风险价值）和范数。该方法利用动量跟踪 f 的雅可比矩阵与函数值（对函数值采用泰勒修正），并将跟踪到的线性化模型传递给广义线性极小化预言机。在有限方差噪声下，对于非凸目标，该方法可达到阶为 K^{-1/4} 的期望广义Frank--Wolfe间隙；当线性化模型构成目标的下界时，可达到阶为 K^{-1/3} 的末次迭代原始误差。该分析还可扩展到重尾噪声情形而无需梯度截断，且对函数值与雅可比矩阵分别采用不同的矩阶数要求。当使用精确预言机时，该方法可退化为……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了混合动量随机Frank--Wolfe这一无投影算法，首次系统性地处理不可微的凸外层函数（如最大值、CVaR和范数）的随机复合优化问题，在有限方差噪声下对非凸目标达到K^{-1/4}收敛率、在模型下界条件下达到K^{-1/3}的末次迭代误差，并将分析扩展到无需截断的重尾噪声情形。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Hybrid Momentum Stochastic Frank-Wolfe, a projection-free method for stochastic compositional optimization with nonsmooth convex outer functions (e.g., maxima, CVaR, and norms), achieving an O(K^{-1/4}) generalized Frank-Wolfe gap for non-convex objectives and O(K^{-1/3}) last-iterate primal error, with analysis extending to heavy-tailed noise without clipping.
